Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that vehicle dealers get proof that an unaccompanied test driver has a driver's license and motor vehicle liability insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motor vehicle dealers; adding a new section tochapter 46.70 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any vehicle dealer who allows a driver to test drive a motorvehicle without an employee of the vehicle dealer accompanying thedriver shall first require proof that (a) the driver possesses a validdriver's license in accordance with RCW 46.20.001, and (b) the driverpossesses motor vehicle liability insurance. For the purposes of thissubsection, possession of an insurance identification card requiredunder RCW 46.30.030 shall be considered proof of motor vehicleliability insurance. The vehicle dealer shall maintain, on file, aphotocopy of the driver's license and insurance identification card. (2) If a driver is unable to provide proof under subsection (1) ofthis section that he or she possesses motor vehicle liabilityinsurance, then the vehicle dealer may not allow the driver to testdrive a motor vehicle unless an employee of the vehicle dealeraccompanies the driver. p. 1 HB 2115 (3) Any violation of this section is a class 1 civil infractionunder chapter 7.80 RCW. (4) Nothing in chapter 46.29 or 46.30 RCW, or Title 48 RCW shall beaffected by this section.
